cost_profile.recommendation_rationale: The full-scale experiment is projected to take approximately 26.9 hours on a single CPU thread. A GPU-accelerated environment on Google Colab Pro (with T4/V100/A100) is recommended to achieve 10x-50x speedups and enable parallel seed execution without saturating workstation CPU cycles.

conclusions.summary_claim: Expanded controlled replay pilot successfully validated. Under high interference (prefix collision), directed replay (C) demonstrates positive mean recovery advantage over random replay (B) (+0.3333) and achieves superiority in 66.7% of evaluated seeds while strictly preserving budget parity. Under low and medium interference, recovery advantage is zero due to minimal baseline forgetting. The protocol is technically validated, reproducible, and ready for full-scale execution.
